description: List the compute calls behind an experiment's recorded assignments, newest first: for each assignment the Elo A/B test built-in recorded, the user, the variant, the compute request id and the usage event id (as list_usage_events and get_receipt name it). Answers 404 not_released where this is not released for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

experiment_key.description: The experiment key: key on a list_experiments result, lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

name: list_experiment_calls
